crossRefs.note: You also put my feet in the stocks, and mark all my paths. You set a bound to the soles of my feet,
They bruised his feet with shackles. His neck was locked in irons,
Then Pashhur struck Jeremiah the prophet and put him in the stocks that were in the upper gate of Benjamin, which was…
who, having received such a command, threw them into the inner prison, and secured their feet in the stocks.
Doesn’t he see my ways, and count all my steps?
All the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing; and he does according to his will in the army of heaven, and…

translations.web: He puts my feet in the stocks. He marks all my paths.’
translations.bsb: He puts my feet in the stocks; He watches over all my paths.’
translations.kjv: He putteth my feet in the stocks, he marketh all my paths.
translations.asv: He putteth my feet in the stocks, He marketh all my paths.
